      • CollectoServerGame

        public CollectoServerGame​(int gameId,
                          CollectoClientHandler p1,

        Instantiates a new CollectoServerGame.
        Parameters:
        gameId - : the id to assign to gameId.
        p1 - : the CollectoClientHandler assigned as player 1.
        p2 - : the CollectoClientHandler assigned as player 2.

    • Method Detail

      • disconnectClient

        public void disconnectClient​(CollectoClientHandler client)
        Removes the passed client handler from the List playingClients and calls the gameOver() method with a DISCONNECT argument.
        Parameters:
        client - : the client handler associated with the disconnected client.
        Requires
        client != null.
        Ensures
        playingClients.remove(client).

      • newGame

        public void newGame()
        Starts a new game by calling the NEWGAME implementation of both client handlers, passing the order and name of the players and the state of the grid of the Board.
        Requires
        playingClients.size() == 2, for (CollectoClientHandler cch : playingClients){cch != null}.

      • receiveMove

        public void receiveMove​(int[] move,
                        CollectoClientHandler player)
        Attempts to play the move passed in the parameter move on the board. If succesful will call MOVE protocol for both client handlers and check whether game is over. If a move is played out of turn or is invalid, the ERROR implementation of the client handler who sent the move will be called.
        Parameters:
        move - : the move sent by the client as an Integer array.
        player - : the client handler who requested the move.
        Requires
        move != null, playingClients.contains(player), board != null, playingClients.size() == 2, for (CollectoClientHandler cch : playingClients){cch != null}.

      • gameOver

        public void gameOver​(CollectoServerGame.Condition condition)
        Ends the game by calling the appropriate protocol implementations to the client handlers, depending on the condition passed as a parameter. This method results in all references to this game to be cleared.
        Parameters:
        condition - : the condition for ending the game as a Condition ENUM.
        Requires
        condition != null, playingClients.size() == 2, for (CollectoClientHandler cch : playingClients){cch != null}.
        Ensures
        playingClients.size() == 0.

      • getWinner

        public void getWinner()
        Count the points of both players and call the gameOver() method with the appropriate Condition based on the amount of points per player.
        Requires
        board != null.
